selected_evidence.summary: Showed pre-change values: all.accept_redirects=0 but default.accept_redirects=1, all.accept_source_route=0 but default.accept_source_route=1

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created disabling ICMP redirects and source-routed packets
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route to 0 for all/default

selected_evidence.requirement: Settings applied at runtime for all interfaces including active eth0
selected_evidence.summary: sysctl -p applied the drop-in and explicit sysctl -w set eth0/lo accept_redirects and accept_source_route to 0
Confirmed OpenRC 'sysctl' service enabled in the boot runlevel, which reads /etc/sysctl.d/*.conf on every boot

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + hardened config)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 97d73d49-2587-4852-8701-8ac02a034b7c and confirmed all/default accept_redirects and accept_source_route were 0 before reboot
Backgrounded 'sleep 2 && reboot' returned 'reboot-scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable during reboot (connection reset/timeout across repeated polls), then returned with a new boot_id 334743c4-7412-42ee-abf5-1c1a5a4993a2 and uptime 17s, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required hardening state and boot service health
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, sysctl service status=started and all/default/eth0 accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed back at 0, proving the persistent config survived the reboot
